description: MCP server for interacting with the Scryfall MTG API
stderr_summary:
npm warn deprecated node-domexception@1.0.0: Use your platform's native DOMException instead
Scryfall MCP Server running on stdio

tools.description: Search for MTG cards by a text query, e.g. 'oracle text includes: draw cards'. Returns a list of matching cards (with basic fields: name, set, collector_number, ID). If no matches are found, returns an error message from Scryfall.

query.description: A full text query, e.g. 't:goblin pow=2 o:haste'

tools.name: search_cards

tools.description: Retrieve a card by its Scryfall ID (a 36-char UUID). Returns the card data in JSON.
tools.name: get_card_by_id

tools.description: Retrieve a card by its exact English name, e.g. 'Black Lotus'. Returns the card data in JSON. If multiple cards share that exact name, Scryfall returns one (usually the most relevant printing).

name.description: Exact name of the card, e.g. 'Lightning Bolt'

tools.name: get_card_by_name

tools.description: Retrieve a random Magic card from Scryfall. Returns JSON data for that random card.
tools.name: random_card

tools.description: Retrieve official rulings for a specified card by Scryfall ID or Oracle ID. Returns an array of rulings. Each ruling has a 'published_at' date and a 'comment' field.

id.description: A Scryfall ID or Oracle ID. Example: 'c09c71fb-7acb-4ffb-a47b-8961a0cf4990'

tools.name: get_rulings

tools.description: Retrieve price information for a card by its Scryfall ID. Returns JSON with usd, usd_foil, eur, tix, etc.
tools.name: get_prices_by_id

tools.description: Retrieve price information for a card by its exact name. Returns JSON with usd, usd_foil, eur, tix, etc.
tools.name: get_prices_by_name
